newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks hit new 1996 high on futures-led buying.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks hit new 1996 high on futures-led buying.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks extended their gains in afternoon trade, with the Hang Seng rising more than 150 points, buoyed by futures-led buying, traders said.
The Hang Seng index was up 145 points at 11,781 after hitting a new 1996 intra-day high at 11,788.41.
September Hang Seng futures, which expire on Friday, rose 122 points to 11,740.
"It seems the buying is mainly derivatives buying," said Boby Ho, dealing manager at GK Goh Securities.
